title: policy/runs.yaml
description: The run launcher's limits (Plan 02): how many runs may be live, how long finished runs are kept and how large each run output may be. Every key is required: the loader fills no defaults.

max_live.description: Runs that may be live at once; the launcher refuses the next one (no queue until Plan 03's poller).

retention_days.description: Days after a run's harvestedAt (set by Plan 03's harvester) that the launcher removes its files; a run with no harvestedAt is never removed, so Plan 02 removes nothing yet (H-206).

output_limits_mb.description: The largest size in MB of each output file copied out of a run; a larger one is not copied out and the run is recorded failed (the run is not stopped for it).
